modmenu.descriptionTranslation.sabercraf: Turns the netherite sword into a cinematic energy saber.
sabercraft.customize.title: Customize saber
sabercraft.customize.unsupported: On this server only possible in creative mode, because SaberCraft is not installed there.
sabercraft.hilt.standard.description: The plain, flat hilt of the first version.
sabercraft.hilt.guardian.description: Classic silver hilt with black grip ridges and a clamp, in the style of an order knight.
sabercraft.hilt.dark_lord.description: Black hilt with silver ribs, red buttons and a toothed emitter. Ignites heavier and hums deeper.
sabercraft.hilt.sentinel.description: Black and silver hilt with a wrapped grip and a vented emitter.
sabercraft.hilt.double.description: Experimental: long hilt with a blade at each end. Both blades ignite together.
sabercraft.style.flowing.description: Quick, flowing cuts in a combo of diagonal, backhand, rising and overhead strikes. A stab while sprinting. Dodges with rolls.
sabercraft.style.heavy.description: Slow, powerful blows from a high stance. A strong thrust while sprinting. Dodges with side steps, forward with a deep lunge.
sabercraft.style.staff.description: Wide sweeps with both blades and turns around the body. The special key starts the blade whirl in front of the body.
sabercraft.ability.no_saber: Ignite a saber in your main hand first.
sabercraft.ability.no_server: Abilities need SaberCraft on the server.
sabercraft.style.defensive.description: Low, wide stance with short, economical cuts close to the body. Longer parry window, blocks hold more and cost less stamina. Slower dodges.
sabercraft.style.agile.description: Blade held high, fast springy cuts with turns, hops and a flip. Quick, cheap dodges, but weaker blocks.
sabercraft.menu.combat.title: Combat, powers and keys
sabercraft.menu.combat.note: What a power does, its cooldown and its stamina cost are decided by the server (config/sabercraft/abilities.json). Here you set what only affects your game.
sabercraft.menu.space.title: Sky and planets
sabercraft.menu.space.note: Stars, nebulae, galaxies, planets and moons instead of the plain night sky, different in every dimension. Only in your game; off = the normal Minecraft sky. With an Iris shader pack it stays off unless you allow it.
sabercraft.menu.music.title: Music
sabercraft.menu.music.note: Original pieces for exploring, night, combat and special moments, with smooth transitions. Replaces the normal game music while it is on. Your own .ogg files go into config/sabercraft/music/<mood>/; only use music you are allowed to use.
sabercraft.menu.graphics.title: Graphics and effects
sabercraft.menu.graphics.note: Fewer particles and a lower sky quality help on slower computers. Sparks, light trails and power effects have fixed limits. "Blade with shaders" only matters while an Iris shader pack is active.
sabercraft.menu.character.title: Character
sabercraft.menu.character.take_saber.des: Gives the saber in your hand the hilt, color and fighting style that go with this outfit.
sabercraft.menu.character.saber_taken: The saber in your hand now matches the outfit.
sabercraft.option.combat_animations.desc: Own attack, defense and dodge animations instead of the normal swing.
sabercraft.option.ready_stance.descripti: Resting and defensive poses while a lit saber is held.
sabercraft.option.ability_hud.descriptio: Cooldowns and stamina next to the hotbar.
sabercraft.option.space_sky.description: The painted starry sky with planets instead of the normal night sky.
sabercraft.option.space_sky_quality.desc: Resolution of the sky: low 256, medium 512, high 1024 pixels per side. Painted in the background.
sabercraft.option.shader_blade.descripti: With an Iris shader pack the blade is drawn as a self-lit beam that the pack knows and lets glow. Off: the old look, which many packs show almost transparent.
sabercraft.option.space_sky_in_end.descr: A space sky of its own in the End too, over the normal End sky.
sabercraft.option.space_sky_with_shaders: Show the sky even while an Iris shader pack is active. Shader packs usually draw their own sky.
sabercraft.option.music.description: Own music for the situation instead of the normal game music. Off = normal Minecraft music.
sabercraft.option.music_volume.descripti: Own volume of the SaberCraft music, on top of Minecraft's music slider.
sabercraft.option.music_crossfade.descri: How long one piece fades out and the next fades in.
sabercraft.option.music_user_files.descr: Also play your own .ogg files from config/sabercraft/music/.
sabercraft.option.blade_trails.descripti: A glowing trail behind the blade during fast movements.
sabercraft.option.trail_strength.descrip: How bright the light trail glows.
sabercraft.option.particles.description: Amount of sparks and power effects.
sabercraft.option.hide_vanilla_sweep.des: Hides Minecraft's white sweep arc next to sabers.
sabercraft.option.camera_motion.descript: How much the camera follows rolls and landings.
sabercraft.option.show_other_outfits.des: Show the outfits other players chose. Off: everyone else looks like their normal skin.
sabercraft.outfit.none.description: Your normal Minecraft skin with all its layers, as set in the skin customization.
sabercraft.outfit.wanderer.description: Light tunic, open brown robe, hood down. Calm and balanced.
sabercraft.outfit.shadow.description: Black robe with a crimson sash, the hood deep over the face.
sabercraft.outfit.sentinel.description: Silver plates over a dark green suit, shoulder pads and greaves.
sabercraft.outfit.scout.description: Light leather vest, yellow scarf, gloves and high boots. Made for agility.
sabercraft.outfit.twilight.description: Dark plate armor with violet light lines and a closed helmet.
sabercraft.outfit.file.description: Your own skins: 64 x 64 PNG in the skin layout in config/sabercraft/outfits/. They replace your skin completely. Only you see them, they are never sent.
sabercraft.hilt.kenobi.description: Silver hilt with black grip rings and a flared, vented emitter. After the saber of a calm master.
sabercraft.hilt.skywalker.description: Black grip, silver body and a long emitter cone with a small control box. After a young knight's self-built saber.
sabercraft.style.djem_so.description: Darth Vader's style: the blade upright in both hands, slow crushing blows from high above that throw the target back. A firm guard, but slow, costly dodges.
sabercraft.style.soresu.description: Obi-Wan Kenobi's style: the blade high over the head, the free hand stretched out. Short controlled cuts and quick ripostes. The longest parry window and the strongest, cheapest blocks.
sabercraft.style.juyo.description: Darth Maul's style with the double blade: the staff carried low, fast sweeps that turn into full spins, a blade whirl. Quick spin steps and back flips, a weaker guard.
sabercraft.character.vader.description: Black armor with helmet, chest panel and cape. Red saber, Djem So style, a deep heavy sound.
sabercraft.character.obi_wan.description: Jedi tunic, brown robe, auburn hair and beard. Blue saber with the Kenobi hilt, Soresu style.
sabercraft.character.maul.description: Black robes, a red and black face, yellow eyes and small horns. Red double blade, Juyo style with fast spins.
sabercraft.character.luke.description: Black Jedi clothes with one black glove, sandy hair. Green saber with the Skywalker hilt, flowing style.
sabercraft.menu.character.characters.des: Famous Star Wars characters. Picking one gives you their look and gives the saber in your hand their hilt, color and fighting style. You can still change everything in the saber menu afterwards.
sabercraft.menu.character.outfits.descri: Original robes and armor as complete skins with their own face. They replace your skin completely; nothing of it stays visible.
sabercraft.menu.character.folder.charact: Your own character skins: 64 x 64 PNG in the skin layout, named after the character (vader.png, obi_wan.png, maul.png, luke.png, anakin.png, yoda.png, dooku.png, ahsoka.png, kylo.png, rey.png) in config/sabercraft/characters/. Replaces the built-in look on this computer.
sabercraft.option.planet.description: Turns the Overworld sky into a Star Wars planet: sky and fog colors, haze, moons, suns and particles. Terrain and world generation stay the same. "Off" = normal sky.
sabercraft.option.planet_particles.descr: Snowflakes on Hoth and falling ash on Mustafar, only under the open sky.
sabercraft.option.planet_horizon.descrip: A far landscape on the horizon (dunes, giant trees, ice mountains, volcanoes with lava and smoke, hills) and details in the sky: air traffic over Coruscant, an aurora over Hoth, clouds over Naboo. Only painted into the sky; the terrain is not changed.
sabercraft.option.planet_shader_tint.des: Only with an Iris shader pack: lays a semi-transparent layer in the planet's sky color over the sky, because shader packs compute the sky color themselves.
sabercraft.planet.none.description: No planet: the normal Minecraft sky (with the space sky at night, if it is on).
sabercraft.planet.tatooine.description: Desert planet: a pale, hot sky, dunes and far mesas on the horizon, two suns, warm evenings and two moons.
sabercraft.planet.coruscant.description: City planet: a hazy sky over an endless skyline with air traffic that lights up in a thousand windows and lights at night.
sabercraft.planet.endor.description: Forest moon: a soft green-blue sky, a wall of giant trees in the mist and the big ringed gas giant above.
sabercraft.planet.hoth.description: Ice planet: cold, pale light, snowy ice mountains on the horizon, two moons, snow in the air and an aurora in the north at night.
sabercraft.planet.mustafar.description: Volcanic planet: a dark red, smoky sky, volcanoes with lava streams and smoke plumes, a lava glow over the horizon and falling ash.
sabercraft.planet.naboo.description: Green lake planet: a clear, deep blue sky with white clouds, soft hills, a big pale moon and a distant second one.
sabercraft.option.music_mode.description: SaberCraft: the mod's built-in music (as before). Star Wars: plays your own music files from config/sabercraft/starwars_music/ to fit the situation. Both modes have separate settings.
sabercraft.option.starwars_volume.descri: Own volume of the Star Wars mode, on top of the master and music sliders.
sabercraft.option.starwars_crossfade.des: On: tracks blend smoothly (length as set in the SaberCraft mode). Off: a short cut.
sabercraft.option.starwars_combat.descri: Music in lightsaber duels, dramatic encounters and boss fights.
sabercraft.option.starwars_exploration.d: Music while exploring by day and in calm moments at night and underground.
sabercraft.option.starwars_character_the: Plays a character's theme when you pick them or another player as that character comes near (e.g. characters/vader.ogg).
sabercraft.menu.music.starwars.reload.de: Reads the folder and mapping.json again after you added files.
sabercraft.menu.music.starwars.empty: No music files found: put .ogg or .wav files into config/sabercraft/starwars_music/ (see README.txt).
sabercraft.menu.music.starwars.context.n: Planets and characters: no files of their own (planets/, characters/<name>/)
sabercraft.menu.music.starwars.note: No film music included. Formats: .ogg and .wav (convert MP3 to .ogg). Folders or mapping.json, see README.txt.
sabercraft.hilt.anakin.description: Black ribbed grip between silver rings, a small gold switch and an angled, clawed emitter. After a bold young knight's saber.
sabercraft.hilt.yoda.description: A short, stout hilt for a small hand with a shorter blade. After an old master's saber.
sabercraft.hilt.dooku.description: Elegant curved hilt for one-handed fencing: dark leather, silver and gold. After a count's saber.
sabercraft.hilt.tano.description: Slim white and silver hilt with black grip rings, made for the reverse grip.
sabercraft.hilt.crossguard.description: Battered dark hilt with a crossguard: two short side blades and a crackling, unstable main blade.
sabercraft.hilt.rey.description: Short bronze hilt with a leather wrap, built from a piece of a scavenger's staff.
sabercraft.style.onslaught.description: Anakin Skywalker's aggressive Form V: a high guard over the shoulder, relentless power blows, a double strike and a leaping attack. Throws targets back, rolls aside quickly, but a weaker guard.
sabercraft.style.ataru.description: Yoda's acrobatic style: low and coiled, somersaults over the target, spinning cuts, a long rolling leap and a whirlwind in the air. The fastest dodges, but a weak guard.
sabercraft.style.makashi.description: Count Dooku's fencing: upright, one-handed, the free hand behind the back. Thrusts, wrist flicks, a disengage and a long flying lunge. A long parry window and cheap blocks.
sabercraft.style.reverse_shien.descripti: Ahsoka Tano's reverse-grip Shien: the blade points back along the forearm. Hooking slashes, a stab behind, rising cuts, low dash cuts and spins. Quick rolls and back flips.
sabercraft.style.unbridled.description: Kylo Ren's raw, wild style: hunched, the blade held low. Huge hammer blows from behind the head, wild wide swings and a frenzy of three strikes. The furthest knockback, but a poor guard.
sabercraft.style.shii_cho.description: Rey's staff-trained Form I: a two-handed middle guard, wide sweeps from side to side with the whole body, a staff twirl in front and a rising charge. A solid all-round guard.
sabercraft.character.anakin.description: Dark Jedi tunic with black leather tabards and a dark robe, brown hair, a scar over one eye, one black glove. Blue saber with the Anakin hilt, Onslaught style.
sabercraft.character.yoda.description: Green skin, wide ears, a few white hairs, a beige tunic and a coarse brown robe. Drawn small. Short green blade, Ataru style with flips and spins.
sabercraft.character.dooku.description: White hair and beard, a dark suit, a long cape with a silver clasp chain. Red saber with the curved Count hilt, Makashi fencing.
sabercraft.character.ahsoka.description: Orange skin with white markings, blue and white striped montrals and head-tails, a dark top with arm wraps. White saber held in the reverse grip.
sabercraft.character.kylo.description: Black helmet with a silver trim, black hooded robes and a quilted tunic. Unstable red crossguard saber, Unbridled style.
sabercraft.character.rey.description: Light wrapped desert clothes, grey arm wraps, a brown belt, hair in three buns. Yellow saber on her staff-piece hilt, Shii-Cho style.
sabercraft.option.character_size.descrip: Draws small characters like Yoda at their size. Only the picture is smaller: the hitbox, the camera and the name tag stay as they are. Off: normal player size.
